s: Who among the following is not a member of the Gentlemen's Agreement?
x:
The Gentlemen's Agreement was signed on 20 February 1956 by representatives of Andhra State and Telangana before the formation of Andhra Pradesh. Signatories included leaders such as Alluri Satyanarayana Raju, Bezawada Gopala Reddy, Neelam Sanjiva Reddy, Marri Chenna Reddy and J. V. Narsinga Rao. Tanguturi Prakasam was not one of the signatories to the Gentlemen's Agreement. Hence, the correct answer is Option (4).
Exam Note:
• Gentlemen's Agreement – 20 February 1956
• Not a Signatory – Tanguturi Prakasam

s: According to the Gentlemen's Agreement, what was the ratio of Cabinet representation for Andhra and Telangana?
x:
The Gentlemen's Agreement, signed in 1956 before the formation of Andhra Pradesh, was intended to safeguard the interests of the Telangana region after its merger with Andhra State. One of its important provisions related to the composition of the State Cabinet. It provided that the Cabinet should consist of ministers in the ratio of 60:40 between Andhra and Telangana, reflecting the relative population of the two regions while ensuring adequate representation for Telangana. The Agreement also included safeguards relating to public employment, expenditure, education and the establishment of the Telangana Regional Committee. Therefore, the correct answer is Option (3).
Exam Note: Important provisions of the Gentlemen's Agreement:
• Cabinet Ratio – 60 : 40
• Telangana Regional Committee
• Safeguards in employment and education
• Protection of Telangana's financial interests

s: During whose reign did N. T. Rama Rao establish the Telugu Desam Party?

Rama Rao) on 29 March 1982 with the objective of protecting Telugu self-respect (Telugu Atma Gauravam) and providing an alternative to the Congress Party.
